output.title: Renovated 5-Bedroom Villa with Mature Garden and Parking in Strassen
output.description:
This detached villa offers 280 m² of living space in the suburban municipality of Strassen, west of the city. The residence maintains a traditional Luxembourg style with a white plaster facade and a pitched slate roof, complemented by a mature, naturally landscaped garden with south-west exposure. The two-storey home includes a private parking area and additional storage facilities.

Inside, the living room presents a warm atmosphere accentuated by parquet flooring, high ceilings, and a wood-burning fireplace. Large patio doors connect this space directly to the garden, facilitating indoor-outdoor living. The renovated kitchen features shaker cabinetry, a central island with seating, granite worktops, and a double oven, designed for both functionality and sociable gatherings.

The villa comprises five bedrooms and three bathrooms. The master bedroom includes fitted wardrobes and offers peaceful views of the garden. Other bedrooms share the renovated and well-appointed bathroom facilities, contributing to the overall comfort of the property.

Strassen is noted for its village character, proximity to good schools, and accessibility to motorways, making it a quiet suburban setting within reach of the city. The property's established garden provides privacy and tranquility, oriented to benefit from the south-west light.

Energy passport: class to be confirmed.
